versions.changelog:
work-productivity-agent-browser-workflow-helper v0.1.0

- Initial release focused on supporting Agent Browser-style workflows for work productivity needs.
- Addresses high user demand for practical help with bug fixes, reliability improvements, safety, and setup hardening.
- Provides step-by-step workflow guidance, ready-to-use artifacts, and reusable checklists/templates.
- Ensures outputs are optimized for local hardware and repeatable tasks.
- Delivers clear validation, assumptions, and next-step notes for actionable results.
